ios.desc:
Vocab Cards turns the words you encounter into lasting knowledge.

Capture a word from Safari, Mail, an article, or a book. Vocab Cards adds a definition and context, then brings the word back with spaced repetition so you remember it when it counts.

BUILD A DECK THAT REFLECTS YOUR LIFE

• Save words from anywhere with the Share extension
• Add lists of words in one tap
• Get definitions, parts of speech, examples, and pronunciation
• Keep personal cards separate from focused study packs

STUDY WITH A PLAN

Choose one-time vocabulary packs built around real study goals:

• SAT Words — 1,100 high-utility academic words in 11 focused sets
• GMAT™ Exam Vocabulary — 300 precision words in 3 sets for arguments, evidence, and business reading
• GRE® General Test Vocabulary — 800 advanced words in 8 sets for Text Completion, Sentence Equivalence, and demanding academic reading

Each pack is previewable, progresses one manageable set at a time, and restores across devices with your Apple ID. Packs are one-time purchases.

REVIEW AT THE RIGHT MOMENT

• SM-2 spaced repetition schedules due cards
• Daily reminders help you keep a steady streak
• Stats and a review heatmap make progress visible
• A Home Screen widget keeps review within reach

AUDIO PRACTICE

Audio Pro adds hands-free spoken practice powered by Gemini. Speak through your due words and practice with natural voice interaction. Audio Pro is an auto-renewing monthly or yearly subscription with a monthly fair-use audio allowance.

SYNC PRIVATELY

Your words and progress sync across your devices with private iCloud sync.

Start with your own words, then choose a pack when you’re ready to study toward a goal.

quotes.text:
A vocabulary flash card app. I know I know, there's a million.

None of them had share extension feature so whenever you are reading on the web or in a book you highlight the word share directly to the app and it automatically looks up the definition.

Also added a voice review (with gemini native audio model) so you can chat your reviews.
